mentions.name: Public Defense Docket Automation Suite
mentions.description: This suite automates docket intake and organization for public defense attorneys in Washington, using Selenium scripts and OS calls. It is currently being packaged as a Windows desktop app for distribution.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve built a small suite of honey-do automations for public defense attorneys in Washington (selenium scripts and OS calls to do docket intake / organization)

Currently packaging as a windows desktop app, recording a demo video, and then distributing
